plugins.name: closedloop-skills
plugins.description: AI Product Discovery skills for Claude Code, powered by ClosedLoop AI. Deep-dive into any topic against all your product insights — every customer quote, pain point, business impact, and competitive signal extracted from your conversations.

skills.name: closedloop-bug-blast-radius
skills.description: Answer how important a bug is: who reported it, how badly, what it is worth, and when it was last reported. Uses get_bug_blast_radius. Read only; reflects reported pain.
headings: Read the coverage block out loud when it bites
skills.description_zh: 只读通过get_bug_blast_radius判断缺陷影响，显示报告人、严重度、商业价值及最近报告时间，反映已报告的痛点。

skills.name: closedloop-case-study-scout
skills.description: Scout case-study and customer-story candidates from ClosedLoop AI evidence. Use when marketing asks for named customer stories, ROI validation, deeper narrative candidates, or interview targets. Uses find_case_study_candidates. Does not send email or grant publication permission.
skills.description_zh: 依据ClosedLoop AI证据寻找客户案例、ROI验证、深入叙事或采访对象，使用find_case_study_candidates；不发送邮件，也不授权发布。

skills.name: closedloop-competitor-gap
skills.description: Competitive intelligence from your actual customer conversations. Shows what customers say about each competitor, where you're winning, where you're losing, and what's at stake commercially. Not desk research — real customer voice with deal context.
headings: Check ClosedLoop AI MCP is available
Step 1: Get the landscape and compute time windows
What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 依据实际客户对话和交易语境开展竞品分析，显示客户评价、赢输原因及商业影响。

skills.name: closedloop-csm-prep
skills.description: 90-second pre-call intelligence brief for CSMs and account managers. One opinionated headline, landmines, what changed, their top concerns in their own words, open threads, and how many other customers share the same pain. Not a data dump — a judgment call.
headings: Check ClosedLoop AI MCP is available
What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 为客户成功和账户经理生成90秒可读的会前情报，提炼重点、雷区、变化、客户原话、开放事项及共享痛点客户数量。

skills.name: closedloop-customer-proof-outreach
skills.description: Draft permission outreach for one selected marketing proof candidate returned by find_customer_proof. Use when the user chooses a customer proof candidate and wants a permission email for website, social, sales, case-study, or live-reference use. Uses prepare_customer_proof_outreach. Draft only; never sends messages or claims permission was granted.
skills.description_zh: 为已选择的ClosedLoop营销证明候选起草网站社交销售案例或现场推荐使用许可邮件，使用prepare_customer_proof_outreach；仅草稿，不发送或宣称获许可。

skills.name: closedloop-customer-proof
skills.description: Find marketing-ready customer proof from ClosedLoop AI evidence. Use when marketing, product marketing, sales enablement, CMO, CEO, or leadership asks for quotes, testimonials, case-study candidates, customer love, launch proof, ROI/value proof, adoption stories, social proof, or reference candidates. Uses find_customer_proof. Do not use for permission outreach drafts; hand selected candidates to closedloop-customer-proof-outreach.
skills.description_zh: 通过find_customer_proof寻找营销可用的引语、推荐、案例、价值ROI、采用故事和参考客户证据；请求许可草稿时将所选候选交配套触达技能。

skills.name: closedloop-deep-dive
skills.description: Deep-dive into any topic against ALL customer evidence from ClosedLoop AI. Reads every matching insight and signal, looks up CRM data for affected customers, and synthesizes the complete picture — what customers say, how severe it is, what revenue is at stake, what competitors are doing, and what workarounds exist.
headings: Check ClosedLoop AI MCP is available
Step 2: Read FULL details for every match
Step 3: Look up CRM data for affected customers
Step 4: Load key conversations for full context
What this skill does NOT do
Data quality: clean before you count
skills.description_zh: 对主题深入读取ClosedLoop AI全部匹配洞察信号并查受影响客户CRM，综合客户表述、严重程度、收入风险、竞品及替代做法。

skills.name: closedloop-pm-prep
skills.description: Pre-call discovery brief for product managers. Not account health — learning goals, knowledge gaps, data-grounded questions, and whether this customer's pain is a market signal or an outlier. Turns a customer call into a research instrument.
headings: Check ClosedLoop AI MCP is available
Step 1: Resolve the customer and get the baseline
When the user picks names — output per-person briefs (~30-40 lines each):
What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 为产品经理准备探索访谈简报，明确学习目标、知识缺口、有数据依据的问题，并判断客户痛点是市场信号或个例，不作账户健康摘要。

skills.name: closedloop-product-ambassador-outreach
skills.description: Draft product ambassador outreach from a selected ClosedLoop AI product ambassador candidate. Use after a customer candidate has been selected from find_product_ambassadors, especially when the user asks to draft an email, ask for an intro, invite a customer to beta validation, request design partner feedback, or prepare product validation outreach. Uses prepare_product_ambassador_outreach. Do not use for finding candidates, marketing quotes, testimonials, public proof, references, case studies, or customer-love requests.
skills.description_zh: 为已选择的ClosedLoop产品大使候选起草介绍、测试验证、设计伙伴或产品反馈触达，使用prepare_product_ambassador_outreach；不用于找候选或营销证明。

skills.name: closedloop-product-ambassadors
skills.description: Find product ambassador candidates from ClosedLoop AI evidence. Use when a product manager, product leader, or founder wants customers for design partnership, beta validation, workflow discovery, expert review, internal championing, or feature feedback for a product area or feature. Uses find_product_ambassadors. Do not use for drafting outreach, marketing quotes, testimonials, case studies, launch proof, references, social proof, or customer-love requests.
skills.description_zh: 通过find_product_ambassadors寻找设计伙伴、测试验证、工作流程探索、专家评审、内部倡导或功能反馈客户；不用于触达草稿或营销引语案例。

skills.name: closedloop-proof-permissions
skills.description: Log and test proof permission requests for selected ClosedLoop AI proof candidates. Uses create_proof_permission_request, get_proof_permission_request, and update_proof_permission_status. Logs fake email only; never sends customer email.
skills.description_zh: 通过ClosedLoop创建查询更新证明许可请求和状态，用于所选证据候选；只记录模拟邮件，不发送客户邮件。

skills.name: closedloop-reference-customers
skills.description: Find private reference customer candidates from ClosedLoop AI evidence. Use when sales or customer-facing teams ask who could be a reference for a prospect, use case, segment, or objection. Uses find_reference_customers. Does not send email or approve introductions.
skills.description_zh: 通过find_reference_customers寻找可私下向潜客推荐的客户候选，按用例、细分或异议匹配；不发送邮件或批准介绍。

skills.name: closedloop-sales-playbook
skills.description: Pain-point sales talk tracks from real customer quotes, workarounds, and competitor gaps. General playbook per topic, or micro-targeted for a specific customer with social proof from their peers.
headings: Check ClosedLoop AI MCP is available
What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 依据真实客户引语、替代方案和竞品缺口制作痛点销售话术，可按主题通用或针对客户附同类客户社会证明。

skills.name: closedloop-sales-proof
skills.description: Build sales proof packets from ClosedLoop AI evidence. Use when sales, sales enablement, marketing, founders, or leadership need customer examples, proof points, snippets, talk tracks, or follow-up copy for prospect conversations. Uses find_sales_proof. Does not send email or claim permission.
skills.description_zh: 通过find_sales_proof制作面向潜客沟通的客户例子、佐证、片段、话术和跟进文案包；不发送邮件或宣称获得许可。

skills.name: closedloop-scope-guard
skills.description: Check a spec, PRD, or ticket against customer evidence before it gets built, and say what to change about it: which requirements to sharpen and how, which to split or merge, which customer needs the spec misses, and which have no evidence behind them. Uses check_scope_evidence. Read only; never recommends against building anything.
headings: Check ClosedLoop AI MCP is available
Say what changes about the spec
skills.description_zh: 只读将规范、PRD或工单与客户证据核对，指出需明确拆分合并的要求、遗漏需求和无证据项；不建议停止建设任何功能。

skills.name: closedloop-send-feedback
skills.description: Send feedback about ClosedLoop AI to the ClosedLoop AI team: bugs, feature requests, missing or low-quality data, confusing outputs, or praise about the platform itself. Uses send_closedloop_feedback. Not for logging the user's own customers' product feedback.
skills.description_zh: 向ClosedLoop AI团队发送平台自身缺陷、功能、数据质量、输出困惑或赞扬反馈；不用于记录用户客户对自身产品的反馈。

skills.name: closedloop-ship-notify
skills.description: Find every customer who asked for something you just shipped, then draft personalized launch follow-up. Uses find_launch_audience. Draft only; never sends customer email.
skills.description_zh: 找到所有曾要求刚上线功能的客户并起草个性化发布跟进，使用find_launch_audience；不发送客户邮件。

skills.name: closedloop-spec
skills.description: Write a Google-design-doc technical spec for a feature, grounded in what customers actually said and in the patterns already in your codebase. Every design decision cites evidence or an existing file. Read only; writes no code and changes no data.
headings: Check ClosedLoop AI MCP is available
Step 1 — Pick the repo to search
Step 3 — Read the codebase before designing anything
skills.description_zh: 依据客户原话与现有代码模式编写Google设计文档式技术规范，每个设计决策引用证据或已有文件；只读，不修改代码和数据。

skills.name: closedloop-synthetic-customer
skills.description: Talk to any customer or segment as an AI persona grounded in real data — call transcripts, product feedback, CRM profiles, and public research. The persona knows what they said, how they talk, what frustrates them, and what they care about. Use when validating features, preparing for calls, understanding a customer's perspective, or testing messaging.
headings: Check ClosedLoop AI MCP is available
Building the persona: Layer 1 — External Context (5 agents in parallel)
Building the persona: Layer 2 — Voice Extraction (multiple agents in parallel)
Building the persona: Layer 3 — Synthesis (2 agents)
skills.description_zh: 将客户或细分群体模拟为有真实转录、反馈、CRM和公开研究依据的AI人物，用于功能验证、会前准备、理解客户及测试消息。

skills.name: closedloop-watch
skills.description: Set up a notification watch — get alerted (Slack / Teams / in-app) when something crosses a threshold in your ClosedLoop AI product insights.
skills.description_zh: 为ClosedLoop产品洞察配置阈值通知监视，在跨过阈值时通过Slack、Teams或应用内提醒。

skills.name: closedloop-weekly-brief
skills.description: Weekly product intelligence brief from ClosedLoop AI. Reads ALL evidence behind every spike, deal blocker, churn risk, and competitor mention — then synthesizes into a 40-line brief a CPO can scan in 60 seconds. Use when the user asks for a weekly brief, weekly summary, weekly update, or what happened this week.
headings: Check ClosedLoop AI MCP is available
Step 1: Detect timezone and compute UTC dates
Data quality: clean before you count
skills.description_zh: 读取ClosedLoop全部峰值、交易阻碍、流失风险和竞品提及背后证据，综合为约40行、供CPO一分钟阅读的周度情报。
